messages:
m1 | B, A, C | 2 | Option 2 accurately renders "lent" ("빌려주었습니다") and uses the passive ("반납되지 않았습니다") to keep ownership and the field team's return obligation clear, whereas Options 1 and 3 drop "they" after "저희는/저희가" ("반납하지 않았습니다") and Option 3's "대여했습니다" confuses lending direction.
m2 | B, B, C | 1, 2 | Options 1 and 2 preserve the subject ("구분" as Classification) and document functions unlike Option 3's "Clarification" and "packing slip", but still need a mandatory edit to romanize the sender identity ("이지연") for English and clarify keeping the delivery note that is inside the box.

m1 | A, B, B | 1 | Option 1 retains the greeting ('안녕하세요' for 'Hi') and maintains document function, whereas Options 2 and 3 omit the greeting.
m2 | A, A, B | 2 | Options 1 and 2 correctly translate '구분' as 'Classification' with Option 2 precisely rendering '사양서' as 'specification sheet', whereas Option 3 mistranslates the subject as 'Clarification'.

m1 | B, A, C | 2 | Source: "They have not returned it." Option 2 uses 반납되지 않았습니다 ("has not been returned"), which keeps the camera ours and the duty to return with the field team. Options 1 and 3 drop the subject after 저희는/저희가 ("we"), so the sentence can read as "we have not returned it." Option 3 also uses 대여했습니다, which can mean lent or borrowed, so it can reverse who owns the camera.

m2 | A, A, B | 1, 2 | Source: 동봉 서류 구분 means sorting out which enclosed document is which. Options 1 and 2 keep that and the instructions to keep, test with and expect each document. Option 3 changes the subject line to "Clarification," which changes what the email says it is for.

m1 | B, A, B | 2 | Option 2 clearly conveys that the camera is still on loan, while 반납하지 않았습니다 in 1 and 3 can carry over “we” as the party responsible for returning it.  
m2 | B, B, B | 2 | All three can make “inside the box” sound like a storage instruction, though the source uses it to identify the delivery note. Option 2 renders 사양서 most precisely as “specification sheet.”
